text: Thank you for the results; your white blood cell count is elevated, though your inflammatory markers (CRP and ESR) are currently normal. Given the combination of wrist pain, fever, and skin lesions, are you experiencing any joint swelling or stiffness, and do you have a history of similar skin rashes?

speaker: Patient
text: 17-year-old male. The patient presents with a 3-day history of pain in his left wrist, which worsened this morning accompanied by chills and malaise. He recounts having a self-resolving left knee pain the previous week. Reports recent return from a camping trip in Minnesota. Sexually active with one female partner. No history of trauma to the wrist.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Lyme Carditis with Migratory Arthritis and Secondary Tenosynovitis.
